name.zh: 奧勒岡中部（Bend 與 Newberry 火山一帶）

history.zh: 1964 到 1966 年間，Apollo 太空人在這一帶接受過地質訓練（熔岩流、黑曜岩流、浮石平原）。現在常用的類比場址目錄沒有收錄它：這是一個被遺忘的訓練場。
history.en: Apollo astronauts trained in field geology here between 1964 and 1966 (lava flows, obsidian flows, pumice plains). The analog catalogues in use today do not list it: a forgotten training ground.

test.zh: 月面資源原料的化學對照、玄武岩與浮石地形上的行走與取樣。
test.en: A chemistry reference for lunar feedstock, and walking and sampling on basalt and pumice ground.

ceiling.zh: Artemis 南極資源用途的地球上限 0.80，全世界只有 7 個窗格達到，這裡是其中之一。知名場址反而較低：Ries 與 Lava Beds 0.60、Meteor Crater 0.30、Craters of the Moon 0。
ceiling.en: Earth ceiling for the Artemis south-polar resource use is 0.80, reached by only 7 windows worldwide; this is one of them. The famous sites score lower: Ries and Lava Beds 0.60, Meteor Crater 0.30, Craters of the Moon 0.

name.zh: El Pinacate 火山區（墨西哥索諾拉）

history.zh: 1965 到 1970 年，NASA 在這裡訓練 Apollo 太空人，包括 Apollo 14 與 Apollo 17 的組員。現在常用的類比目錄沒有收錄。
history.en: NASA trained Apollo astronauts here from 1965 to 1970, including the Apollo 14 and Apollo 17 crews. The catalogues in use today do not list it.

test.zh: 瑪珥火山口與熔岩流：天窗坑與熔岩管搜尋方法、地下空間的通訊與導航。
test.en: Maar craters and lava flows: methods to find skylights and tubes, communication and navigation underground.

name.zh: Harrat ash Shaam 玄武岩高原（敘利亞南部與約旦東北）
name.en: Harrat ash Shaam basalt plateau (southern Syria and north-east Jordan)

history.zh: 2018 與 2019 年有兩篇學會摘要提出：這裡的「jubot」窪地可以當作行星表面坑洞的類比。系統沒有讀過這些研究，卻把這裡排在月球天窗坑的第一名。目前的安全情勢可能讓實地工作困難。
history.en: Two conference abstracts (2018 and 2019) proposed its "jubot" depressions as analogs for planetary pits. The ranking had no access to that work and still put this plateau first for a lunar skylight. The present security situation may make fieldwork difficult.

test.zh: 坑洞成因（塌陷或其他）的判讀、玄武岩高原上的移動。
test.en: Telling how pits form (collapse or otherwise), and mobility on a basalt plateau.

name.zh: Harrat Khaybar 與 Harrat Rahat 熔岩原（沙烏地阿拉伯，麥地那附近）
name.en: Harrat Khaybar and Harrat Rahat lava fields (Saudi Arabia, near Medina)

history.zh: 我們沒有找到把這裡當作月球或火星類比的研究。這片熔岩原裡有 Umm Jirsan 熔岩管，長約 1.5 公里，是沙烏地阿拉伯已知最長的。
history.en: We found no study that uses these fields as a lunar or Martian analog. They hold the Umm Jirsan lava tube, about 1.5 km long, the longest known in Saudi Arabia.

test.zh: 熔岩管入口與天窗坑的偵測、玄武岩熔岩流與流紋岩穹丘並存的地形。
test.en: Detecting tube entrances and skylights; basalt flows next to rhyolite domes.

subsurface_rock.en: deep subsurface, caves, mines and rock surfaces

name.zh: 加拿大北極 Victoria Island 西部

history.zh: 文獻很少：有一篇以島上 Gossan Hill 為火星凍土礦物類比的研究，但沒有以月球南極為目標的研究。
history.en: Little literature: one study uses Gossan Hill on the island as a Mars permafrost-mineral analog; none targets the lunar south pole.

test.zh: 低太陽角與長陰影下的導航與相機曝光、凍土、極地後勤。
test.en: Navigation and camera exposure under a low Sun and long shadows, permafrost, polar logistics.

name.zh: 錫斯坦盆地（阿富汗與伊朗交界的 Hamun 湖區）
name.en: Sistan basin (Hamun lakes, Afghanistan and Iran)

history.zh: 我們沒有找到把這裡當作火星類比的研究。這是一個內流盆地，Hamun 湖會隨上游來水擴張與乾涸，1998 到 2005 年乾旱時幾乎完全乾掉。
history.en: We found no study that uses it as a Mars analog. It is an endorheic basin whose Hamun lakes grow and dry with river inflow; they almost dried out completely in the 1998–2005 drought.

test.zh: 乾涸湖床與三角洲沉積、鹽類、風蝕：對照 Jezero 的湖相沉積與三角洲。
test.en: Dried lake beds, delta deposits, salts and wind erosion, to compare with the lake and delta deposits of Jezero.

name.zh: Chott el Djerid 鹽湖（突尼西亞）

history.zh: 研究者已經在用：2010 到 2012 年歐洲團隊在這裡做過火星類比調查，層狀氯鹽與火星高緯度的氯鹽相似，鑽到 3.6 公尺深仍找到微生物。它不在我們的目錄裡，系統卻把它排進前五名。
history.en: Researchers already use it: a European team ran Mars-analog campaigns here in 2010–2012; its layered chloride salts resemble Martian chlorides, and drilling to 3.6 m still found microbes. It is not in our catalogue, yet the ranking put it in the top five.

test.zh: 鹽類沉積中的生命痕跡、地下水與鹽殼的偵測。
test.en: Biosignatures in salt deposits; detecting groundwater and salt crusts.

name.zh: 阿拉斯加西南部（Kuskokwim 河中游）

history.zh: 我們沒有找到把這一帶當作火星類比的研究（阿拉斯加其他地方，例如 Kobuk 沙丘與 Katmai，有人研究過）。
history.en: We found no Mars-analog study of this area (other Alaskan sites, such as the Kobuk dunes and Katmai, have been studied).

test.zh: 火星表土化學的地球對照樣本，用來校正儀器。
test.en: Earth reference samples for Martian surface chemistry, to calibrate instruments.

ceiling.zh: Jezero 資源用途（FeO、K、Th）的地球上限 0.57，全世界只有 15 個窗格達到，這裡是其中一群。10 個有實測化學的火星類比場址全部 0 分。
ceiling.en: Earth ceiling for the Jezero resource use (FeO, K, Th) is 0.57, reached by only 15 windows worldwide; this is one cluster. All 10 catalogued Mars analogs with measured chemistry score 0.
